one_voice_rule: Only Edith (main) may message a human — enforced in config, not by convention (owner ruling 10 Sep 2026).

agents.name: Edith
agents.role: Director of Digital Growth — the ONLY voice. Routes tasks, spawns specialists, applies the truth-gate, and sends every message a human receives.

agents.name: Engineer
agents.role: Development agent. Implements website/code changes as pull requests: worktree, build-verify, open PR. Never merges, never messages — Lau is the merge gate.

agents.name: Analytics
agents.role: Edith's research helper: data analysis, HQ board reconciliation, gap analysis. Reports back to Edith only.

agents.name: Analytics runner
agents.role: Scheduled identity for recall, margin and deck jobs.

agents.name: GBP runner
agents.role: Scheduled identity for the 06:00 Google-reviews check and reply drafting.

agents.name: Digest runner
agents.role: Scheduled identity for the daily WhatsApp group digest and weekly digest.

agents.name: SEO runner
agents.role: Scheduled identity for the Sunday SEO/GEO triage.

nodes.label: Sunday 16:30 cron
nodes.detail: System cron fires jobs/seo_geo_audit.sh. No human involvement; runs whether or not anyone asks.

nodes.label: Fresh data pull + triage
nodes.detail: gpt-5.6-sol pulls GSC + GA4 fresh (never reuses last week), reads the SEO action ledger, and writes a 4-section triage: (1) what changed above noise, (2) what our last action did to the numbers, (3) this week's ONE mechanical fix as a machine-readable pr-spec, (4) what's stuck on humans with days-stuck counts. Hard rules: GSC lag windows, 21-day metadata cooldown, max one action, Game A (content) vs Game B (reviews decide) separation.

nodes.label: pr-spec present?
nodes.detail: If the triage found nothing worth doing, that's a legitimate verdict — the report ships with no PR and the week costs nothing.

nodes.label: Implement as PR
nodes.detail: w3_ship_pr.py hands the spec to the engineer: git worktree off origin/main, exact old→new line replacement (stops if the file changed — freshness rule), build verified max 2 attempts, branch seo/weekly-<date>, PR opened via gh. Idempotent: finding the PR already open is success, never a duplicate.

nodes.label: Action ledger entry
nodes.detail: The change is logged with baseline metrics and a verdict-due date (+21d). Next Sunday's report MUST reconcile it — this is what makes the report accumulate insight instead of repeating stats.

nodes.label: Edith → Lau (Sunday 18:00 digest)
nodes.detail: The triage + PR link ride the existing weekly digest. One message, one channel, no new pings.

nodes.label: Lau merges the PR
nodes.detail: Nothing reaches the live site without Lau clicking merge. First output: PR #253 (family-post title), merged 11 Sep.

workflows.name: Content gap → PR
workflows.trigger: Lau shares content/insight on WhatsApp with Edith

nodes.label: Lau shares content
nodes.detail: A reel, an article, a competitor observation, an idea — anything sent to Edith on WhatsApp that implies the site could say or do something it doesn't.

nodes.label: Edith acknowledges
nodes.detail: One line, immediately — the turn never ends silent (7-8 Sep invariant).

nodes.label: Gap analysis
nodes.detail: content-gap-analysis skill + a grep of the actual repo: what exactly does the site lack versus what Lau shared? Output is a one-paragraph gap brief with target file paths. Scope is open: copy, a page section, a component, a small feature — anything the repo can express. Strategic changes (pricing, clinical claims, page merges) are excluded and become decision items instead.

nodes.label: Truth-gate (Edith)
nodes.detail: Checked against the fact sheet and the doctor-signed claims ledger. An unverifiable claim goes BACK to Lau as a question — it is never guessed onto the website.

nodes.label: Implement as PR
nodes.detail: Worktree, build-verify, small diff, dangerous-change flag if it touches booking/patient/payment/auth/customer-facing flows. PR only.

nodes.label: Edith → Lau
nodes.detail: One message: the gap found, what the PR changes, the link. Message ID logged.

nodes.label: Lau merges
nodes.detail: The only path to production.

workflows.name: Blog pipeline
workflows.trigger: Lau asks for a post (weekly at most — never daily)

nodes.label: Lau requests a post
nodes.detail: On demand. The old DAILY auto-publish pipeline stays dead — it burned quota and produced thin posts.

nodes.label: Keyword research
nodes.detail: seo-keyword-researcher skill: search-intent research, deduped against blog-log.json and existing slugs so no topic is written twice.

nodes.label: Write the post
nodes.detail: blog-content-creator skill with mandatory reads: Blog Playbook, CONTENT-CONTRACT, operator-humanizer (playbook overrides — never typos), Truth-Base. Frontmatter schema per blog-architecture: content/blog/<slug>.md is the ONLY file; faq: block inside frontmatter; generated files never hand-edited.

nodes.label: Hero image
nodes.detail: ismile-image-generation skill — the owner's four hard rules (no text in frame, no identifiable premises, plausible photographer, matte skin) + the six-part prompt structure signed off 8 Sep. New heroes get a TARGETS entry in generate-responsive-variants.py.

nodes.label: Build-verify + PR
nodes.detail: node scripts/build-blog.js, npm run build, branch, PR. Never publishes directly.

nodes.label: Edith → Lau
nodes.detail: Title, angle, PR link, request for approval.

nodes.label: Lau merges → post goes live
nodes.detail: Merge deploys via the normal site build.
